What I believe

People don't make poor choices — they make the best choices they can with the information they have.

My ambition is to expand that information and broaden perspective. I create content at the intersection of AI, finance, self-growth, and real-life decision-making — translating insights from books, data, and everyday experience into practical guidance. So that people can make life choices from a place of awareness, not autopilot.

Mindset shapes reality. MIND UP.

Current Life Razor

“Be Dumb, Don't worry about what others think”

A razor is a rule you cut your life with. Mine is a reminder to stay curious, keep asking the “dumb” questions, and never let the noise of other people's opinions decide my next step.

Advice to my 20-year-old self

“With awareness, mindset shifts — small actions matter, kindness multiplies, and investing in people changes lives”

Small actions matter

The small choices, words, and actions that often go overlooked create big ripple effects over time.

Kindness multiplies

Kindness and intention, even in difficult times, influence others and build trust and support.

Invest in people

Attention, empathy, and belief can transform lives — including your own.

Modest Beginnings

I always knew what I wanted

Growing up with almost nothing, money was always tight and travelling the world felt borderline impossible. But my parents never compromised on education — believing, unwaveringly, that my sisters and I would change the trajectory of our family.

I had a three-step plan:

01

Study computer engineering

A first step that a kid from a modest home in India could barely dare to dream of.

02

Grow in the IT industry

Rise fast and learn from global enterprise leaders, working closely with CXOs across Europe.

03

Give back to society

Turn everything learned into published books, mentorship, and free education.

My 20s

A journey of highs and lows

It wasn't a straight line. It was a winding path of momentum, doubt, and leaps of faith — each low quietly building the next high.

  1. The start

    TCS · Belgium

    A high point

    My career begins in Europe. I'm growing professionally, living abroad, building a solid life on paper. It feels like everything is going well.

  2. 3 years

    Belgium & Luxembourg

    A low point

    I travel across Europe, and the journeys slowly turn inward. Difficult questions about purpose, direction, and what truly matters start surfacing.

  3. The leap

    Back to India

    The turn

    With a strong conviction and an early habit of investing — but no concrete plan — I decide to return to India. That decision changes everything.

  4. Turning point

    IIIT Bangalore

    A high point

    On a mentor's suggestion, I apply for the Data Science program. Getting through was a milestone, but the year there transforms how I think, learn, and solve.

  5. 7+ years

    The Netherlands

    A high point

    I return to Europe and spend over seven years working as a Data & AI Expert — while discovering a deep desire to write, reflect, and share.

  6. The books

    Author

    A high point

    That journey of sharing leads me to author books alongside my work. Today my story sits at the intersection of technology, self-discovery, and lifelong learning.

Today, my story sits at the intersection of technology, self-discovery, and lifelong learning — and it's still unfolding.
